# jayptl.me

> Jay Patel's personal portfolio. Jay is a software engineer from Anand, Gujarat, India working across full-stack, mobile, and applied AI in TypeScript, Dart/Flutter, Python, and Solidity, with 32 shipped projects spanning mobile, web, backend, and self-hosted infrastructure. Headline: Software Engineer: Full-Stack, Mobile and Applied AI. Contact: hello@jayptl.me.

Every page is also available as Markdown by sending `Accept: text/markdown` (e.g. `curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://jayptl.me/projects`) or by fetching the `.md` URLs listed below.

## About

- [About Jay Patel](https://jayptl.me/about.md): Roles, background, hackathon wins, certifications, and what Jay builds outside client work.
- [Resume](https://jayptl.me/resume.md): Canonical HTML resume as Markdown, summary, skills, selected work, education, tailored PDF slots, and machine-readable resume.json.

## Pages

- [Contact](https://jayptl.me/contact.md): Email, time zone, what Jay is open to (full-time, contract, forward deployed engineering).
- [Book a call](https://jayptl.me/book.md): Pick a 15 minute slot; the Google Meet link arrives by email 15 minutes before.
- [Now](https://jayptl.me/now.md): What Jay is building and training this month.
- [Uses](https://jayptl.me/uses.md): Languages and frameworks by lane, and the homelab.
- [AI](https://jayptl.me/ai.md): What Jay builds with AI, how he uses assistants, and what he never hands to them.
- [Colophon](https://jayptl.me/colophon.md): How this site is made.
- [Changelog](https://jayptl.me/changelog.md): Dated site updates.

## Projects

- [Projects index](https://jayptl.me/projects.md): All 32 shipped projects with featured case-study links.
- [Aviz Health case study](https://jayptl.me/projects/aviz-health.md): Digital healthcare ecosystem, three Flutter apps, Next.js 16 admin console, Bun + Hono backend, live on Google Play v2.0.
- [Swalook CRM case study](https://jayptl.me/projects/swalook.md): Enterprise salon-management SaaS overhaul, Next.js 16 Turborepo, 35+ OpenAPI-documented endpoints, ML Kit AR previews.
- [Genuinest case study](https://jayptl.me/projects/genuinest.md): Founding Engineer (Contract) work, Flutter product plus migration to self-hosted Docker/Coolify/Traefik with 20TB MinIO.
- [Vini & Tini case study](https://jayptl.me/projects/vini-tini.md): Two small language models trained from scratch: Vini, a BitNet b1.58 edge assistant (jayptl-rq/vini-pico), and Tini, a dense TypeScript coder (weights not public yet).

## API

- [OpenAPI specification](https://jayptl.me/openapi.json): Machine-readable description of every public endpoint, content types, and error format.
- [Health endpoint](https://jayptl.me/api/health): Liveness probe returning JSON service status.
- [Error format](https://jayptl.me/openapi.json): JSON error bodies (`error.code`, `error.message`, `error.hint`) for /api/* paths and JSON-preferring clients.

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](https://jayptl.me/privacy.md): Consent-only analytics, no personal data collection, GDPR basis.
- [Security policy](https://jayptl.me/.well-known/security.txt): How to report security issues.
